caption: The drawing features a rectangular area with a light beige background, bordered by a thin, double-lined frame. Within the bordered area, there are several floral elements distributed across the composition. The central focus is a cluster of flowers with purple and light maroon petals, green leaves, and stems, along with some brown and pink rounded shapes resembling buds or berries. Smaller floral motifs are scattered in the surrounding space, rendered in light green, white, and pink. In the upper left and lower corners of the rectangle, there are additional floral accents, including a cluster of pink berries with green leaves at the upper left, a red-petaled flower in the lower left, and a blue-petaled flower in the lower right. The overall composition is sparse with considerable empty space between the floral elements. Handwritten text appears in the lower right outside the bordered area, reading "Federal Art Project W.P.A. of Va By Ward Starnes."
title: Dress
